scope: Define and author-check a source-backed canonical 21-mer sequence-query workload, preserving ordered repeated queries and explicit N/boundary rules; public E. coli reference as a replay fixture, no production-trace or speedup claim
result: All 100000 prefix positions agree across rank2a, persisted8 and suffix_array with a forward canonical-window tally. The original 64 sampled keys plus the first repeated key also pass the unchanged direct oracle and certificate checker. 21 tests pass; no original or accepted evidence changed.
limitations: Reference-derived workload modeled on a documented software operation, not captured application traffic
Full-prefix tally shares the query iterator; independent direct checks cover 65 unique keys only
Corpus is one exposed ACGT record; N/boundary/even-palindrome controls are small Python tests
No Jellyfish/KAT executable run, production RAM requirement, throughput comparison or scientific acceptance
